mapper.sql: schedule_id AS scheduleId, doctor_id AS doctorId, schedule_date AS scheduleDate, shift_type AS shiftType, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, department_id AS departmentId, room_number AS roomNumber, max_patients AS maxPatients, remaining_slots AS remainingSlots, status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM doctor_schedule ORDER BY schedule_date DESC, start_time ASC
SELECT FROM doctor_schedule WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM doctor_schedule WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND status = 1 AND remaining_slots > 0 AND schedule_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY schedule_date ASC, start_time ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM doctor_schedule WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND status = 1 AND remaining_slots > 0 AND schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} ORDER BY start_time ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM doctor_schedule WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY schedule_date DESC, start_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctor_schedule(doctor_id, schedule_date, shift_type, start_time, end_time, department_id, room_number, max_patients, remaining_slots, status) VALUES(#{doctorId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{shiftType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{departmentId}, #{roomNumber}, #{maxPatients}, COALESCE(#{remainingSlots}, #{maxPatients}), #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_schedule SET doctor_id = #{doctorId}, schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}, shift_type = #{shiftType}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, department_id = #{departmentId}, room_number = #{roomNumber}, max_patients = #{maxPatients}, remaining_slots = COALESCE(#{remainingSlots}, remaining_slots), status = #{status} WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
UPDATE doctor_schedule SET remaining_slots = remaining_slots - 1 WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND remaining_slots > 0
